title: Stuck in the elevator lobby?
content: Anyone else ever essentially stuck in the lobby with maybe two halls of elevators? You go up in an elevator only to somehow end up back in the lobby elevator section? It’s always a feeling of needing to leave that area but no choice is ever the right choice. When I finally decided to actually leave the lobby(I was chased out), I found myself on the edge of a very very very tall open air high up structure with coliseum vibes, a beautiful skyline, and steep steep stairs. The only way down was to leap from the side and fly down and into the city.
